title: Integrated Modeling Tool for Indexing and Analyzing State Machine Trace

publication.venue: 2021 IEEE International Symposium on Networks, Computers and Communications (ISNCC)

abstract: The accessible abstract describes a modeled state representation with a special-purpose database, filtering/highlighting, and Gantt/XY views for Linux and Windows traces.
abstract_source: Abstract mirror and authoritative metadata, paraphrased; full text not obtained.

summary.core_contribution: The abstract presents an integrated tool for indexing, querying, and visualizing state-machine traces.
summary.problem: Large state-machine traces need structured indexing and interactive views so analysts can filter and inspect state intervals efficiently.
summary.method: At abstract level, the tool models states, stores them in a special-purpose database, and provides filtering/highlighting with Gantt and XY visualizations for Linux and Windows examples.
summary.findings: The abstract indicates that the tool supports the described trace views; no scale, latency, or comparative metric is verified.
summary.limitations: The exact data model, storage engine, workloads, measurements, and paper-specific threats to validity remain unverified.
